content: Spike complete. Confirmed the user's .NET 11 preview.7 / Aspire 13.5.3 / Agent Framework 1.20.0 stack is internally consistent except for one stale, unused, dead package pin (Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Ollama @ 9.7.0-preview, ~1 year behind, unreferenced by any code) which was removed from Directory.Packages.props and ProjectName.Runtime.csproj -- most plausible cause of the 'Ollama unknown' IDE complaint given the user's own report that 'everything builds'. Both edits were left uncommitted since the two files already carry the user's own unrelated in-progress edits; the user should fold them into their own next commit. Separately confirmed the .NET Aspire MCP server ('aspire agent mcp', STDIO, 14 tools, no auth needed) is real and current, and is not restricted to the four officially-wired clients -- it can be added to this repo's own PMCR-O skill runtime as an MCP server. Filing a next_seed for the planner role to scope an actual plugins/pmcro-aspire skill around it, since building that plugin was explicitly out of scope for this spike.

next_seed.summary: Scope and build a plugins/pmcro-aspire PMCR-O skill that wraps the .NET Aspire MCP server ('aspire agent mcp', STDIO transport) so PMCR-O cycles can query live Aspire resource state, console/structured logs, and traces (via list_resources/list_console_logs/list_structured_logs/list_traces/execute_resource_command) as part of Make/Check evidence, per the research recorded in trail ba0c2c65-075f-470b-abed-e5647053dc8b step 2.
